name: appqlks
description: AppHotel – room service, housekeeping & AI concierge for boutique hotels

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,admin,guest -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web-admin" "npm run dev -w apps/guest-app"
scripts.android: npm run android:build -w apps/guest-app && npm run android:open -w apps/guest-app
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web-admin && npm run build -w apps/guest-app
